info.title: Upload Product Image
info.description:
Upload local images to TikTok Shop for use as product images, variant images, size charts, certification images and so on.
**Note**:

* All images used in TikTok Shop products must be uploaded through this API. You will not be able to use any image URLs that are not hosted by TikTok Shop.
* You must store the response body to retrieve the ID or URL required to associate the image with a product during product creation or editing.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

data.description:
The local image file to be uploaded.

**Note**:
- Supported formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, BMP
- Max size: 10MB
- Dimensions: [100x100 px, 20000x20000 px]
- For `use_case=MAIN_IMAGE`, the dimensions must be between 300x300 px and 4000x4000 px.
- For `use_case=SIZE_CHART_IMAGE`, the dimension must be at least 1024 px on the shorter side.

use_case.description:
The usage scenario of the image.
Possible values:
- MAIN_IMAGE: An image displayed in the product image gallery.
- ATTRIBUTE_IMAGE: An image that represents a product variant (e.g. color).
- DESCRIPTION_IMAGE: An image used within the product description.
- CERTIFICATION_IMAGE: An image to provide supporting information to meet TikTok Shop requirements for listing restricted products (e.g., images of certifications, product packaging, labeling).
- SIZE_CHART_IMAGE: An image that displays the product's measurement details.
- CUSTOMIZATION_IMAGE: Images used for POD product customization, such as background images, mask images, or default images configured for customizable areas. These images are used to render or preview consumer-customizable product content.

**Note**: Images for use cases `MAIN_IMAGE` and `ATTRIBUTE_IMAGE` that do not fit within the 3:4 to 4:3 aspect ratio range will be automatically converted to 1:1.

uri.description:
The URI to identify the image in API requests and responses.
Pass this value when creating or editing a product to associate the image with the product.

url.description: The URL to access and view the image. Use this URL in product descriptions by embedding it within an HTML `` tag.

height.description: The height of the image after aspect ratio adjustment.

width.description: The width of the image after aspect ratio adjustment.
